verdict.rationale: Metronome is a usage-based billing SaaS platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The llms.txt file, OpenAPI spec, SDKs and REST API are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
